# pdf-lib (PDF writer)

`pdf-lib.esm.min.js` is the unmodified ES module build of [pdf-lib](https://pdf-lib.js.org/),
version 1.17.1, by Andrew Dillon, licensed under the MIT License (`LICENSE.md`). It bundles pako
(MIT) and other small MIT dependencies. Loaded by `assets/js/shared/pdf.js` only when someone
uses a PDF tool. The build copies it as it is.
